# Russell Dinnager's Open Science Notebook

> An open science notebook documenting ecology research, statistical methods, and daily research notes from a researcher at ANU and CSIRO.

This site serves as a public research journal combining ecology research, topic modeling analysis, and phylogenetics work. It features posts on R programming, open science practices, and career development in academic research.
